alignments.name: Lawful Good
alignments.beginner_description: Do what is right while respecting order and duty.

alignments.name: Neutral Good
alignments.beginner_description: Help others without being strongly bound to order or rebellion.

alignments.name: Chaotic Good
alignments.beginner_description: Follow conscience and personal freedom while helping others.

alignments.name: Lawful Neutral
alignments.beginner_description: Follow law, tradition, or a personal code.

alignments.name: Neutral
alignments.beginner_description: Choose what seems best without a strong moral or orderly extreme.

alignments.name: Chaotic Neutral
alignments.beginner_description: Value personal freedom and follow changing impulses.

alignments.name: Lawful Evil
alignments.beginner_description: Pursue selfish ends within a code or hierarchy.

alignments.name: Neutral Evil
alignments.beginner_description: Pursue selfish ends without loyalty to order or freedom.

alignments.name: Chaotic Evil
alignments.beginner_description: Act with destructive selfishness and little restraint.

skills.name: Arcana
skills.beginner_description: Recall lore about magic and the planes.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.beginner_description: Climb, jump, swim, and exert force.

skills.name: History
skills.beginner_description: Recall historical people, places, and events.

skills.name: Intimidation
skills.beginner_description: Influence through threats or force of presence.

skills.name: Investigation
skills.beginner_description: Find information and deduce how things work.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.beginner_description: Diagnose illness or determine causes of injury and death.

skills.name: Nature
skills.beginner_description: Recall lore about terrain, plants, animals, and weather.

skills.name: Performance
skills.beginner_description: Act, tell stories, make music, or dance.

skills.name: Religion
skills.beginner_description: Recall lore about gods, rituals, and holy symbols.

skills.name: Sleight of Hand
skills.beginner_description: Pick pockets, conceal objects, and perform legerdemain.

skills.name: Survival
skills.beginner_description: Track, forage, navigate, and avoid natural hazards.

languages.name: Common
languages.beginner_description: Every player character knows Common automatically.

languages.name: Draconic
languages.beginner_description: A standard language associated with dragons and dragonborn.

languages.name: Dwarvish
languages.beginner_description: A standard language associated with dwarves.

languages.name: Elvish
languages.beginner_description: A standard language associated with elves.

languages.name: Giant
languages.beginner_description: A standard language associated with giants.

languages.name: Gnomish
languages.beginner_description: A standard language associated with gnomes.

languages.name: Halfling
languages.beginner_description: A standard language associated with halflings.

languages.name: Orc
languages.beginner_description: A standard language associated with orcs.

gaming_sets.name: Dice Set
gaming_sets.beginner_description: A compact set of gaming dice.

gaming_sets.name: Playing Card Set
gaming_sets.beginner_description: A deck used for many games.

standard_array.name: Standard Array
standard_array.beginner_description: Assign 15, 14, 13, 12, 10, and 8 once each among the six abilities.

background.name: Soldier
background.beginner_description: A martial background granting physical ability increases, combat-oriented skills, Savage Attacker, and one gaming-set proficiency.

species.name: Human
species.beginner_description: A versatile Humanoid with Resourceful, Skillful, and Versatile traits.

character_class.name: Fighter
character_class.beginner_description: A level-one martial class trained with all standard armor and weapons.

features.name: Resourceful
features.beginner_description: Gain Heroic Inspiration after finishing a Long Rest.

features.name: Skillful
features.beginner_description: Gain proficiency in one chosen skill.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.beginner_description: Choose one supported Fighting Style feat.

features.name: Second Wind
features.beginner_description: Two uses at level one; a use can restore 1d10 plus Fighter level Hit Points.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.beginner_description: Use the mastery properties of three selected Simple or Martial weapon kinds.

origin_feats.name: Savage Attacker
origin_feats.beginner_description: Once per turn, roll weapon damage dice twice and use either roll.

origin_feats.name: Alert
origin_feats.beginner_description: Add Proficiency Bonus to Initiative and potentially swap Initiative with a willing ally.

origin_feats.name: Skilled
origin_feats.beginner_description: Gain three additional supported skill proficiencies in this initial slice.

fighting_styles.name: Archery
fighting_styles.beginner_description: Improve attack rolls made with ranged weapons.
fighting_styles.effect_summary: +2 to attack rolls with Ranged weapons

fighting_styles.name: Defense
fighting_styles.beginner_description: Improve Armor Class while wearing armor.
fighting_styles.effect_summary: +1 Armor Class while wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor

fighting_styles.name: Great Weapon Fighting
fighting_styles.beginner_description: Raise very low damage-die results with eligible two-handed melee weapons.
fighting_styles.effect_summary: Treat eligible weapon damage-die results of 1 or 2 as 3

fighting_styles.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
fighting_styles.beginner_description: Add the ability modifier to eligible extra Light-weapon attack damage.
fighting_styles.effect_summary: Add the ability modifier to eligible Light-weapon extra-attack damage

weapons.name: Javelin
weapons.beginner_description: A Simple melee weapon that can be thrown.

weapons.name: Greatsword
weapons.beginner_description: A heavy, two-handed Martial melee weapon.

equipment_packages.name: Fighter Equipment A
equipment_packages.beginner_description: The supported Strength-focused Fighter equipment package.
